title: Top 5 SSL Providers for Small Business - WebU

facts.fact: The article lists five SSL providers for small businesses: HostGator, Comodo, Bluehost, SiteGround, and Let's Encrypt.
facts.quote: Top 5 SSL Providers for Small Business

facts.fact: The author states that Let's Encrypt provides free SSL certificates to anyone who needs them.
facts.quote: Yes, you read that right. Free. Let’s Encrypt is the superhero of the SSL world, providing free certificates to anyone who needs them.

facts.fact: The author states that Bluehost offers one-click SSL installation.
facts.quote: They make it easier to secure your website by offering one-click SSL installation.
